channel.title: SSbusinessAndMarket
channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from SSbusinessAndMarket, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: ‘The most European of non-European countries’: Canada looks to become an ‘associate member’ of the EU as ‘economic pressure’ from the U.S. looms
item.description: Trump has suggested Canada’s proposed EU arrangement could be a “hostile act” and threatened tariffs on Europe if he considered it unfriendly.

item.title: ‘Operation Supercharge’: Japan and U.S. agree to develop Japanese missile facility—a ‘strong, quiet and clear’ message against China’s naval activity
item.description: Japanese Defense Minister Shinjiro Koizumi made the announcement in a news conference where he met U.S. Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth.

item.title: Does home insurance cover storm damage?
item.description: Home insurance will typically cover various types of storm damage, but you may face exclusions for flooding or sewer backup damage without added cover...

item.title: ‘It was just a fight that we decided to pick’: Serval raises $150 million at a $3 billion valuation to take on ServiceNow
item.description: Sequoia led the $150 million round and is doubling down. ServiceNow says AI makes it easier to build a startup, not to run an enterprise.
